newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Manuel hints at fx control news in S.Africa budget.
newsitem.headline: Manuel hints at fx control news in S.Africa budget.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel told parliament on Wednesday the government had no specific timetable for the relaxation of foreign exchange controls but hinted at an announcement in the March 12 budget.
Asked by Democratic Party MP Ken Andrews about the impact of the rand's recent strength on exchange control policy, Manuel replied:
"In view of the appreciating value of the rand, I would invite the Honourable Andrews to have patience until Budget Day. There is exactly one month to Budget Day, let's not spoil our fun yet."
